§6Electrolyzer§f

§aUses electrical energy to split fluids.§f
The §bElectrolyzer§f takes §b1 fluid input§f and produces §bup to 4 fluid outputs§f. Default cycle is §b3200 ticks§f at §b40 RF/t§f. It's the slowest NC machine but produces up to 4 different fluid outputs per recipe.

Used for electrolyzing water into hydrogen and oxygen, splitting molten salts, and other electrochemical processes. Essential for some reactor coolant and fuel production chains.

§cWARNING:§f The Electrolyzer is a power hog at 40 RF/t and very slow. Budget accordingly.

§ePS:§f Speed Upgrades help, but even with upgrades this machine is slow. Plan your production lines around its throughput.
